texts.text: Well, hello there.

transfers.text: Hello, hello. I heard you're the new trader around here?

texts.text: That's right, they call me Sapyr. Nice to meet you.
Nah, only just got here. Why do you ask?

transfers.text: Well, Sapyr, Sidorovich has some questions for you. Why are you trading on his territory?

texts.text: So that's it. Here's the thing, see: Sidorovich rips off rookies, doesn't let them buy at fair prices. I climbed up from the bottom myself, survived doing cheap jobs for that hustler... And now I've got the chance to sell goods for a lot less.

transfers.text: That's all well and good, but you're wrecking the business of the guy I work for.

texts.text: I understand you. So let me ask you this: do you really value your job with Sidorovich?

transfers.text: What's the point of that question?

texts.text: I want to offer you a deal. You tell Sidorovich you settled things with me. And I really will move somewhere else, far from Sidorovich. For that, I'll pay you 1000 rubles, plus I'll give you good jobs and a discount on goods.

transfers.text: No way. Wrap up your business here the easy way, or we'll settle this a different way.

stages.title: Sapyr
stages.message:
Received: 1000 rubles 
Task updated: Return to Sidorovich

texts.text: I'm glad it worked out this way. You won't see me here again. Here's the money, I'll get in touch with you soon.
So what exactly are you offering me? Just up and close shop, just like that?
And what exactly are you going to do about it? I've got armed guards standing right here, and you're just a rookie without any decent gear.

transfers.text: Fair enough. Still, wrecking the business of someone who's been here for years isn't a good idea. He might not just send me next time.

texts.text: Message received. But don't forget, nothing in this world lasts forever, and Sidorovich isn't forever either. What happens next is an interesting question. Good luck.
There was a stalker's corpse lying in the room.
PDA #****. Callsign: Vovka Lightfoot. Rank: veteran. Stash: 1. Data uploaded to the PDA.
Note #44: Found some strange PDA, it's very different from any I've seen before. Should show it to Sidorovich.
Note #46: There's some indicator blinking on this PDA. Tried turning it off, pulling out the battery — still blinking. Very strange.

Note #54: Got a message on my PDA, someone's writing that I should come to the Grain Elevator, or I won't wake up the next morning. Who could this be? Sent a beacon to Sidorovich, hope he understands if something happens.

Note #55: I came to the Grain Elevator, watched the area from the bushes for 20 minutes, but noticed nothing. Went inside, nothing there either. Sent another beacon to Sidorovich. Everything's very strange. Could this be connected to the PDA somehow?

note: PDA #****. Callsign: Vovka Lightfoot. Rank: veteran. Note #44: Found some strange PDA, it's very different from any I've seen before. Should show it to Sidorovich... Note #46: There's some indicator blinking on this PDA. Tried turning it off, pulling out the battery — still blinking. Very strange... Note #54: Got a message on my PDA, someone's writing that I should come to the Grain Elevator, or I won't wake up the next morning. Who could this be? Sent a beacon to Sidorovich, hope he understands if something happens... Note #55: I came to the Grain Elevator, watched the area from the bushes for 20 minutes, but noticed nothing. Went inside, nothing there either. Sent another beacon to Sidorovich. Everything's very strange. Could this be connected to the PDA somehow?

texts.text: End of recording. Notes downloaded.

transfers.text: Take the flash drive and PDA

texts.text: Stay right where you are, or you'll catch a bullet between the eyes
Stay right where you are, or you'll catch a bullet between the eyes
That's not really important, who I am. What are you doing here?

transfers.text: I heard rustling, looked in, and there was a bandit rummaging over a corpse. Tried to shoot him, but he got away.

texts.text: A bandit, you say? Then why were you digging through the stalker's things yourself?

transfers.text: Was checking in case he was still alive

texts.text: Well, let's have a look too, see if he's alive or not.

transfers.text: Go ahead, you won't see anything new

texts.text: Did you find anything on him?

transfers.text: I didn't even look at anything, just checked his pulse

texts.text: The device is in place.
The device is gone.
Maybe you'd like to give us back our PDA after all? We'll pay you for it.
Well well. Go on, show me the thing, let me see if it's the right one.
Excellent... Now get lost before you earn a hole in your head.
Eat lead!
Can't you see? There's a war on here! What the hell are you doing here?

transfers.text: I need a stalker nicknamed Raven, where is he?

texts.text: How the hell should I know?! Nobody's seen him around here in a while, they say because of all our infighting here he took off to wait it out somewhere quieter, so to speak.

transfers.text: Do you know anything about the Monolith fighter they found here?

texts.text: I don't know anything! Get out of here already, if you're not going to help us...
We'd be grateful for the help!

transfers.text: What do I need to do?

texts.text: Looks like it's all handled. Thanks for wanting to help, but we managed on our own.

transfers.text: But I still need to find out where Raven went?

stages.title: Unknown stalker
stages.message: Task updated: go to the pipes

texts.text: Alright, you helped us out. Since he took off from here, he's been spotted a few times in the shelter near the pipes. They say even the flesh mutants ran off after he showed up there — I don't believe that part, but I do know the guy who told me is trustworthy and experienced. That's everything I know, good luck, stalker.
You bastard, get out of my sight!
It's all over now anyway. But you could've helped instead of bailing like a rat.

transfers.text: Listen, tell me what you know and I'll toss you some cash

stages.title: Unknown stalker
stages.message:
Money lost: 500 rubles.
Task updated: go to the pipes

texts.text: Fine, you bought me. Lucky for you I need cash badly right now. They say Raven's been hanging around the shelter near the pipes — at least that's what a trustworthy guy told me, and I believe him. That's it, get going.
What are you doing here? Get lost!

transfers.text: I'm from Sidorovich, he said you know where that Monolith fighter's body came from

texts.text: Why should I believe you instead of putting a bullet in your head?
Alright. Come over here.

transfers.text: What do you know about that dead Monolith fighter?

texts.text: They dragged him here...

transfers.text: Did you see who did it?

texts.text: Bandits, they brought him here already dead as a distraction.

transfers.text: Why the distraction? What's going to happen?

texts.text: They're planning to hit the Depot with a huge mob, damn it, the stalkers there probably won't even survive!

transfers.text: Thanks for the info, I have to warn them!

stages.title: Raven
stages.message: Task updated: Return to the Depot

texts.text: You've got a good soul, I can see that. Won't wish you luck — this is the Zone, you understand.
So what do you need this time?

transfers.text: You need to get out of here right now

texts.text: Why? We're managing just fine, we even sent a squad to find out about that Monolith fighter.

transfers.text: It's a trap. Raven told me they're preparing a massive assault on the Depot

texts.text: Oh damn! Hey guys! Get ready to defend the Depot, fast, we're about to be attacked.

transfers.text: Are you sure you can hold the Depot?

texts.text: Yeah, of course! We'll hole up in the best hiding spots and set an ambush, teach them a lesson. Thanks, brother.
Explore the farm grounds.
Who are you?
Well, let's say I'm Syava. I'm listening.

transfers.text: I'm @name. I'm looking for a stalker, he was carrying important information for the Barman. Haven't seen anyone around here?

texts.text: I'm the very stalker carrying the info for the Barman. Have they already lost me?

transfers.text: As you can see, since I'm here

texts.text: Here's the situation: I owe a Duty guy at the checkpoint, he promised to shoot my knee if he sees me without the money. It'd be fine, but when I tried to get through the checkpoint with the info, they wouldn't let me through and nearly shot me, heh. Barely made it out here, but I can't deliver the flash drive right now. Will you help deliver it?

stages.title: Syava
stages.message: Item received: Flash drive, vodka x2, gasket x2

texts.text: Much appreciated, stalker. Here, take a bit of loot, it's all I've got for now. And the flash drive. God willing, we'll cross paths again in better circumstances.

stages.title: Syava
stages.message: Task updated: Go to the Barman

texts.text: By the way, if it's not too much trouble, apologize to the Barman for me.
Go ahead and move along, don't cause a fuss here.

transfers.text: Guys, I need Molotov, where can I find him?

texts.text: I'm Molotov. What do you need?

transfers.text: I've come to pay off Syava's debt. From the Barman

stages.title: Molotov
stages.message:
Money lost: 3000 rubles
Task updated: Return to the Barman

texts.text: So even the Barman is sticking up for him now, interesting. Fine, hand it over and be on your way.
Hey, stalker. Can you help me?

I was coming back from a raid, from Garbage, and I see a group of stalkers approaching. Figured, nothing to worry about. But... turns out I was wrong — one of them clubbed me from behind while the other two were chatting me up, asking what's going on in Garbage. Would've been fine, but they stole a family heirloom. Can you help get it back? I'd do it myself, but whoever hit me really got me good — I'm still seeing double.

transfers.text: What kind of heirloom did they steal?

texts.text: A tanto. There's an emerald dragon on the handle, and symbols on the blade.

transfers.text: Sorry, I've got no time at all, can't help

texts.text: Understood, sorry for bothering you
Thank you so much.

transfers.text: Were there any distinguishing marks, or maybe a nickname?

texts.text: There was something... One of them had a scar across half his face, and the other's nickname started with 'S', I think. That's all I remember.

transfers.text: Alright, wait here. I'll be back soon

texts.text: I'm listening closely

transfers.text: Greetings, Wolf. I've got a question for you

texts.text: Hey. Go ahead

transfers.text: Have you seen any group heading toward Garbage? One of them has a scar across half his face

texts.text: Nah, sorry, so many rookies run past me, can't keep track of them all. Ask Sidorovich, maybe he'll know something — if they're headed to Garbage, they'd definitely need to stock up on gear.
You again?

transfers.text: Wolf, can you tell me about Strizh's gang?

texts.text: Not much to tell. Used to be a stalker, and a clumsy one at that. Nearly walked straight into a Carousel out in the open during basic training, then went running from dogs — realized he couldn't earn an honest living, so he decided to start a racket and found himself some like-minded partners. They set up camp not far from the ATP and go miles out of their way around the village just to stop by Sidorovich's for supplies.
What do you want?

transfers.text: You've got something that isn't yours. Give it back.

texts.text: Ha-ha-ha. Or what? You're alone here, there's three of us, we'll pop you and that's that! They'll find your corpse near some anomaly, and your loot stays with us.

transfers.text: You sure I'm alone here? A stalker hired me and a whole squad to get the tanto back, and how doesn't really matter now. Right now your buddy's head is sitting in a scope, and with just one wave of my hand...
Alright guys, sorry, I got carried away, I'll be going now

texts.text: Hey, easy now! Fine, what do you need?
Where do you think you're going?

stages.title: Strizh
stages.message: Task updated: Return the tanto to Shogun.

texts.text: Fine. Here.

transfers.text: Don't let me see you again

texts.text: You died, the quest has failed.
So, how'd it go?

transfers.text: Here. Take the tanto. Had to work for it.

texts.text: Thank you! You have no idea how much this means to me. If you ever need help, you know where to find me. And... here, take your reward.
Good luck to you, brother.
He-ey, buddy, c'mere!
Look, dude, listen, wanna make some cash?
Now that's what I'm talkin' about! Look, bro: I need you to deliver a couple Kalashes and this here box to my boys at the Freedom base.

transfers.text: Aren't you guys not on good terms with Freedom?

texts.text: Not on good terms. But don't you go tellin' anyone about this — it'll be our little secret. Deal?

transfers.text: So what's in the box, then?

texts.text: Now that you'll find out in the next episode.
You'll get paid once the cargo's delivered.

transfers.text: Nah, this whole thing sounds sketchy, too risky. Bye.
I'm in. Alright, bring over your Kalashes and the box.

texts.text: Here, take this... One shortened AKS-74 here... And here's the second one.

transfers.text: These are so beat up... The second one's even wrapped in electrical tape

texts.text: Don't you worry about that. What matters here?

stages.title: Bandit
stages.message: New quest: reach the Freedom base

texts.text: Nah, what matters is this box right here. The Kalashes are just cover — if there's Duty guys along the way to the base, they might search you. What the hell would they want with these busted-up Kalashes anyway. They won't even wanna touch 'em, let alone check 'em, afraid they'll fall apart. Now I'll hide the box in the 'Ksyukha's' magazine, no rat's gonna find it. You'll deliver it all no problem... Alright, that's it, saddle up.
Access to the Freedom base is temporarily closed!
Last name, first name, patronymic, purpose of visit!
Ah, c'mon, that was a joke! Make yourself at home.

transfers.text: Alright, I've got a delivery here — a couple Kalashes. Someone order these?

texts.text: Ah, that's, I think, for our trader. He's actually here, I'll call him over.
'Sup. What brings you here? Trading in a gun or buying something else?
And what's in it?

transfers.text: Two busted-up Kalashes and some kind of box.

texts.text: Not busted-up, rare. Could easily sell these to some rich bigshots on safari for triple the price... Nah, actually, these aren't rare at all... They really are busted-up. '93 was the last good production year... Alright, let's see about this mysterious box... Hidden pretty well, can't even pull it out with your fingers, but lucky for us, pliers are always at hand!
Here you go. And tell the sender that next time he shouldn't jam boxes so deep into magazines — Duty hasn't shown up around here in ages anyway.
If you want to make another five hundred, you can take these Kalashes back. Full payment on delivery.

stages.title: Recipient
stages.message: New quest: Return to the bandits

texts.text: Well, take care then

stages.title: Recipient
stages.message: Quest completed: deliver the cargo to Freedom

texts.text: Well, take care then
Well, well! So, everything went smoothly?

transfers.text: Yeah, delivered everything. And the Recipient asked me to tell you not to cram the boxes into the magazines so hard next time — Duty hasn't shown up around there in a while.

texts.text: Yeah. You already got your reward.

transfers.text: The Recipient also asked me to return the Kalashnikovs to you for an extra fee.

stages.title: Bandit
stages.message: Quest completed: deliver cargo to Freedom. Received: 500 rubles

texts.text: Yeah, here — take it.
You approach the farm.
